head_commit.message:
feat: Security & Reliability - Fix Silent Errors and Add Monitoring

- Fix silent event handling in TUI backtrack overlay
- Add proper PTY write error handling with logging
- Prevent infinite loops in process ID allocation with bounded attempts
- Add broadcast channel message loss monitoring and alerts
- Improve MCP tool loading with user feedback for failures
- Add session manager statistics and capacity monitoring

All changes maintain backward compatibility and follow existing code patterns.

head_commit.message:
Fix: /undo destructively interacts with git staging (#8214) (#8303)

Fixes #8214 by removing the '--staged' flag from the undo git restore
command. This ensures that while the working tree is reverted to the
snapshot state, the user's staged changes (index) are preserved,
preventing data loss. Also adds a regression test.

head_commit.message:
Fix: /undo destructively interacts with git staging (#8214) (#8303)

Fixes #8214 by removing the '--staged' flag from the undo git restore
command. This ensures that while the working tree is reverted to the
snapshot state, the user's staged changes (index) are preserved,
preventing data loss. Also adds a regression test.
